description: Defines the ObliviousHttpGateway class responsible for server-side decryption and encryption of HTTP payloads using HPKE, including BSSL initialization and key management.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpGateway
classes.description: Implements server-side handling of Oblivious HTTP requests and responses, managing HPKE keys and encryption/decryption processes.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ObliviousHttpGateway with optional custom QuicheRandom.

methods.name: DecryptObliviousHttpRequest
methods.description: Decrypts incoming encrypted HTTP request payloads.

methods.name: CreateObliviousHttpResponse
methods.description: Creates encrypted HTTP responses based on plaintext data and request context.
